title: calophyllum inophyllum var. wakamatsui
intro: Calophyllum inophyllum var. wakamatsui, commonly known as the Pacific Calophyllum, is a variant of the Calophyllum inophyllum plant species. This plant is a medicinal species that has been used for its diverse health benefits. The Pacific Calophyllum is known to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its health benefits in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Pacific Calophyllum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
